reason: The weighty bills (rows 1, 2, 4, 5, 12: repeal of the Jordanian-era ban on selling land to non-Jordanians, i.e. allowing Israelis/Jews to buy land in Judea and Samaria) carry most of the weight and are exactly what the statement asks. The land-registry access bills (rows 3, 6) serve the same goal by letting buyers check ownership; the restitution and land-holder bills (rows 7-11) are light and point the same way. The price (harder future territorial agreement) is an honest one.
